import sys

def solve():
    MOD = 1000000007
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    visited = [False] * p
    ans = 1
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not visited[i]:
            j = i
            while not visited[j]:
                visited[j] = True
                j = (k * j) % p
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    if k == 1:
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
